scenario: 检索系统不只要把文档找近，还要知道近在哪里、找回后能不能答对。Axis-LoRA 强调时间与人物的区别，RAGCompass 按答案表现选证据，QE-RAG 则把输错问题单独拿来测。评估时先分清查询、候选证据和最终答案，别让一个平均检索分数替整个系统作答。

papers.title: RAGCompass: Generalizable Retriever Routing via Reranking
papers.authors: Valentin Six, Mufei Li, Dongqi Fu, Yinglong Xia, Hong Li, Pan Li
papers.abstract:
Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus.
To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. We contrastively fine-tune a reranker against the answer each evidence set produces, which accounts for most of the gain; a small comparison head adds a moderate improvement, and neither component has retriever-specific parameters.
RAGCompass improves answer F1 by 28% relative to the best fixed retriever, and outperforms fusion baselines, three query-only routers, and a prompted 8B language model. Generalization experiments show that RAGCompass keeps most of its gain under an unseen corpus, retriever, or reader, while query-only baselines fall to the best fixed retriever or below.
papers.summary: 同一个问题，该选哪路检索，不能只凭问题本身猜。RAGCompass 先让各检索器取回证据，共享重排器分别读问题与每组文本，比较层让各组表示互相做注意力，再输出分数，取最高一组。训练标签来自固定生成器用各组证据答题的 F1，而不是文档相关性。全量测试中，答案 F1 比最优固定检索器高2.28个百分点。它是在检索之后挑证据，仍需先运行各路检索；筛过易分胜负的问题所得到的更大提升，不能直接当成全部流量收益。

papers.title: CORE: Coarse-to-Fine Search with Context Management for Deep Research
papers.authors: Hoang Tran Vuong, Ngoc Quan Pham, Hung Bui, Fatih Porikli, Dat Quoc Nguyen
papers.abstract:
Deep research agents answer complex questions through repeated search. They rely on a harness that runs their tool calls and returns evidence to their context. This creates a trade-off: Search works best over long passages, which give enough context for reliable semantic matching. But the returned evidence should be short, because every observation stays in the agent's context for the rest of the trajectory.
We introduce CORE, a training-free harness that combines coarse-to-fine search with context management. CORE retrieves passages with a dense retriever. It then reuses the token-level similarities from a late-interaction reranker to return only the most relevant snippet from each passage. Context management lets the agent expand the context around sources it has already retrieved and suppresses repeated snippets.
In controlled closed-search comparisons with the Tongyi DeepResearch and OpenResearcher harnesses, CORE achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and evidence recall across three agent models and three benchmarks (BrowseComp-Plus, BrowseComp-Wikipedia and BrowseComp-Plus-CM), on corpora containing up to 553M documents.
papers.summary: 研究 agent 越搜越多，不一定需要把整段材料反复塞进上下文。CORE 先找候选段落，再在段内挑与子问题最相关的短片段；信息不够时，回到已见文档找相关段及其前一段。重复片段只留引用，新片段仍完整展示。在固定语料的 BrowseComp-Plus 对照中，同一 agent 从仅粗检索的62.61%准确率，升至完整方案的80.12%。提升来自检索和上下文管理的组合，不是只靠把上下文裁短。

papers.title: RAG without Forgetting: Continual Query-Infused Key Memory
papers.authors: Yuntong Hu, Sha Li, Naren Ramakrishnan, Liang Zhao
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems commonly improve robustness via query-time adaptations such as query expansion and iterative retrieval. While effective, these approaches are inherently stateless: adaptations are recomputed for each query and discarded thereafter, precluding cumulative learning and repeatedly incurring inference-time cost. Index-side approaches like key expansion introduce persistence but rely on offline preprocessing or heuristic updates that are weakly aligned with downstream task utility, leading to semantic drift and noise accumulation. We propose Evolving Retrieval Memory (ERM), a training-free framework that transforms transient query-time gains into persistent retrieval improvements. ERM updates the retrieval index through correctness-gated feedback, selectively attributes atomic expansion signals to the document keys they benefit, and progressively evolves keys via stable, norm-bounded updates. We show that query and key expansion are theoretically
papers.summary: 一次成功的查询扩写，能留作下次检索的文档记忆。ERM 给每份文档的每条扩写记分：检索或回答判对后，先筛出加到文档向量后能提高原查询相似度的扩写。对同一文档，把同一查询各扩写的增益做 softmax，用各权重乘对应增益，累加到该文档各条扩写的分数。每批选累计分最高的若干条扩写，作为一组送入编码器，再将所得向量加到文档向量。不训练模型，测试问题也不参与记忆更新；结果不能外推为长期线上无偏差。

papers.title: Reducing Representational Interference in Retrieval Embeddings with Trainable Prefix Tokens
papers.authors: Seongtae Hong, Youngjoon Jang, Jungseob Lee, Chanjun Park, Heuiseok Lim
papers.abstract:
Embedding models compress variable-length text into fixed-size vector representations, but this compression can entangle semantic content with residual token-level information, such as artifacts arising from attention sink behavior. We propose a simple method that prepends trainable [DUMP] tokens to the input during embedding model training.
The method keeps the model architecture, pooling strategy, and training loss unchanged, while optimizing the added tokens through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. By introducing trainable prefix positions that interact with regular tokens during encoding, [DUMP] tokens help reduce the influence of residual or uninformative token-level signals on the final retrieval representation.
Experiments on standard retrieval and long-context benchmarks show that our method consistently improves over finetuned baselines across encoder and decoder embedding models. Further analysis shows that [DUMP] tokens alter token-level activation and attention patterns associated with low-information tokens. These results suggest that trainable prefix tokens provide a lightweight way to improve retrieval representations.
papers.summary: 文本压成检索向量时，位置和低信息 token 的影响也可能混进去。这项方法给问题和文档都加可训练的 [DUMP] 前缀，让它们与正文一起参与注意力；编码器仍取 [CLS] 的表示，decoder 取最后 token 的表示，不改检索损失。EuroBERT 在标准检索集合上的平均 NDCG@10 从0.5786升至0.5884。前缀与模型共同微调，推理时也保留；不是随手加几个特殊 token，就能让原模型零训练提分。

papers.title: CONFRAG: Confidence-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Yin Huang, Yifan Ethan Xu, Kai Sun, Vera Yan, Alicia Yi Sun
papers.abstract: Production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pays retrieval latency and serving cost on every query -even when the model already knows the answer.We present CONFRAG, a confidence-guided strategy that invokes RAG only when a large language model (LLM) is unlikely to be correct, cutting external retrievals by 5-39% and tail latency by up to 800ms (P90) in a real RAG system while matching the answer quality of always-on RAG.CONFRAG is enabled by CONFQA, a lightweight fine-tuning strategy (one epoch over 3K knowledge-graph facts) that teaches an LLM to answer only when confident and otherwise say "I am unsure", cutting hallucination rates from 20-40% to 5% or below across multiple factuality benchmarks.Two choices make it work in practice: a dampening prompt that discourages overconfident hallucinations, and training on atomic facts that generalizes confidence calibration to unseen domains and question types.At serving time, LLM-QA and RAG run in parallel with earlystopping, so confiden

papers.title: Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract:
Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap.
A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law).
Margins are small in five corpora and two embedding models, so an idealised tolerance at the level of floating-point noise leaves up to 5.5% of queries exposed (at most 1.2% in any corpus once exact duplicate documents are excluded), and a threshold calibrated from our CPU INT8-FP32 comparison of a small embedding model (at the empirical 0.1% quantile of honest cosines) leaves 98-100% exposed; on a Raspberry Pi 5 running a local language model, such an attack lowers correct answers from 0.75 to 0.39.
Integrity audits of compressed vector stores fare no better: on a FAISS product-quantisation index over 57,638 documents, tampered vectors that all pass the audit put the attacker's document first for 25% of targets. Verifying quantisation codes instead, with ambiguity decided by the verifier, a calibrated guard band and canonicalisation, accepted every honest vector in our samples on three platforms and left the publisher no choice.
We also show that common floating-point and dynamic-INT8 inference pipelines are not bit-reproducible across batch sizes or architectures, and report pre-registered negative results on abstention, context pruning and semantic screening. We release code and data.
papers.summary: 知识包签名有效，检索仍可能被改过的向量带偏。这项研究把威胁放在持有签名权限的发布方：文本通过审查，配套向量却被定向调整。在 SQuAD 的 BGE-M3 实验中，若存储向量与按文本重算的向量只需余弦相似度达到0.999，相关段落原本排首的问题里，24.6%存在可夺走首位的扰动。这是逐问题选择攻击的暴露度，不是一个坏索引同时劫持全部这些问题；来源签名与文本、向量的一致性需要分开验证。

papers.title: Axis-LoRA: Probing and Adapting Embedding Models for Personal-Memory Retrieval
papers.authors: Dohoon Kim, Junho Park, Hyunwoong Bae, Seyoon Kim, Taesup Moon
papers.abstract:
As LLMs are increasingly asked questions about a user's personal experiences, retrieval must distinguish memories by time, place, person, and event. Current personal-memory pipelines rely on frozen dense embedding models to embed memories for retrieval, but we find that these models do not capture the four axes well. Swapping a memory's date or place barely shifts its embedding, and a trained projection on top of the frozen embedding does not recover the missing signal.
The problem lives inside the model, where each axis is encoded by a distinct attention-head pattern. Guided by these findings, we propose Axis-LoRA, a per-axis adapter that places four LoRA branches inside the embedding model and combines them via a per-query gate.
Across three standard embedding models evaluated on LongMemEval, ATM-Bench, and LoCoMo, Axis-LoRA improves 4-benchmark mean R@10 by $+1.28$ to $+1.56$~pp while training only a small fraction of the base parameters on a small axis-counterfactual training set. Code is available at https://github.com/dohoonkim-ai/axis-lora.
papers.summary: 个人记忆里，同一件事换了时间、地点或人物，通用向量未必分得清。Axis-LoRA 分别学习时间、空间、实体和事件的适配器，再由问题决定各项相似度的权重，加到冻结模型的原分数上；训练负例只改其中一类信息，逼模型看清差别。各编码器在个人记忆测试上的平均 R@10 提高1.28–1.56个百分点，单项仍有回退；Qwen 的通用检索 NDCG@10 均值也下降0.50点。它是在放大特定记忆线索，不是无代价提升全部检索。

papers.title: Test-Time Optimization of Query Embeddings with Ranking Aware Reward Maximization
papers.abstract:
Dense retrievers rank documents using vector similarity between a frozen encoder and a precomputed index. While test-time ranking rewards from a reranker or LLM judge can improve results, existing methods discard this signal after a single query. Updating the retriever's weights makes rewards reusable, but this requires parameter access, which is unavailable for closed-source models, and is computationally prohibitive.
We propose TTT-Embed (Test-Time Tuning of Embeddings), a framework that distills ranking rewards into a lightweight, learned vector within the output embedding space of a frozen model. This vector is optimized purely from scalar ranking scores assigned to the retriever's own candidate documents, requiring no access to model weights, ground-truth labels, or modifications to index.
A single scope parameter controls rewards reuse (global, task, or query), enabling a principled trade-off between reusability and specificity under a fixed reward computation budget. We demonstrate that as the available reward budget scales, the optimal sharing scope shifts dynamically from global-wise to task-wise and finally to query-wise. Evaluated across five embedding models and 15 MTEB retrieval tasks, TTT-Embed improves test-time retrieval by up to +8.36 nDCG@10.
Crucially, the learned states generalize effectively to unseen queries (up to +8.57 nDCG@10) and unseen tasks (up to +4.71 nDCG@10). Furthermore, TTT-Embed successfully resolves catastrophic forgetting: by leaving base weights entirely frozen, it recovers degraded general capabilities (up to +8.00 nDCG@10, even surpassing the original base model) while preserving in-domain specialization.
These results establish ranking rewards as a reusable test-time state, enabling budget-efficient adaptation for any embedding model, including closed-source APIs.
papers.summary: 重排器打过的分，不一定只能用来调整眼前几个候选。TTT-Embed 用这些分数学习任务内共享的偏移向量，让修改后的查询排序接近重排判断；再把偏移加到查询向量上，归一化后重新从全库召回，不改 embedding 模型或文档索引。MTEB 测试中，平均每问题十次文档评分预算下，任务共享方案的 NDCG@10 提高6.36点，同预算直接重排提高3.21点。评分仍有成本，最合适的共享范围也随预算变化。

papers.title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
papers.authors: Zhihan Yin, Ruyi Li, Chengyu Fang, Yifeng Yao, Nonghai Zhang, Pengfei Xiong, Terry Zhang, Huishuai Zhang, Dongyan Zhao
papers.abstract: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names a
papers.summary: 找答案有时要先找到一张图，再顺着图里的人或物继续查。ModalSearcher 用文本、图像交替连接的关系图合成训练题，隐藏会直接泄露答案路径的实体名，让 agent 自己决定何时搜图、何时回到文本。图只用于离线造数据，线上仍在真实网络调用搜索工具。同工具环境下，训练后的模型比原始 Qwen3-VL-8B 在多模态知识问答上的平均准确率高16.2点。收益属于整套数据与训练方案，改写题目也不能保证所有题都必须靠图才能解。

papers.title: QE-RAG: A Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation Benchmark for Query Entry Errors
papers.authors: Kepu Zhang, Zhongxiang Sun, Weijie Yu, Xiaoxue Zang, Kai Zheng
papers.abstract: Current benchmarks evaluate the performance of RAG methods from various perspectives, they share a common assumption that user queries used for retrieval are error-free. However, in real-world interactions between users and LLMs, query entry errors are frequent. The impact of these errors on current RAG methods against such errors remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose QE-RAG, the first robust RAG benchmark designed specifically to evaluate performance against query entry errors. We analyze the impact of these errors on LLM outputs and find that corrupted queries degrade model performance, which can be mitigated through query correction and training a robust retriever for retrieving relevant documents. Based on these insights, we propose a contrastive learning-based robust retriever training method and a retrieval-augmented query correction method. Extensive experiments reveal that: (1) state-of-the-art RAG methods including sequential, branching, and iterative meth

papers.summary: 问题输错了，先让大模型润色一遍，未必比直接检索好。QE-RAG 保持答案标注不变，给部分问题注入输入错误，检查检索和生成会在哪一步受影响。它还训练纠错模型：先读带错问题取回的文档，再输出原本正确的问题，用改好的问题重新做 RAG。在40%问题带错的测试中，该方案平均答案 F1 从普通 RAG 的34.39升至37.52，直接提示纠错反而更差。要测的是保住原意，而不只是把句子改顺。
